Chapter 6494: Sent Flying

Chapter 6494: Sent Flying

The seal unleashed an inferno ravaging the dream world. Spatial fabrics broke down and more of reality could be seen.

It smashed the golden bull against the spatial wall, creating a pit with the real world beyond.

“Invincible!” The ancestor of all gods regained his balance and channeled more paragon power despite being unable to handle it.

The divine rings erupted as the ancestor soared towards the bull like a meteor. The bull roared in response and galloped forward with raised horns.

The fight caused devastating damage to the dream world and destroyed countless minor realms.

The bull leaped upward and thrust the ancestor, causing incredible shockwaves. Fortunately, the dream still survived since the three souls were around.

“Suppress!” Seventy-two Origin and Trinity activated the seal again.

Other laws and powers were extinguished except the golden power. The bull fell to the pressure and the ancestor took advantage of this, stomping down on it.

Alch-deer and the others struggled but couldn’t break free, suffering further internal injuries.

“Shit, stomped to death this time?!” The skull shouted.

“Can’t you excavate Splendor Spring?” The soul asked.

“You do it, isn’t this your dream?” The skull said.

“My dream, yes, but it’s your spring. Aren’t you an immortal? An immortal should be able to wipe away this dream world with one exhale.” The soul retorted.

“One exhale my ass! If I were still an immortal, would you assholes be able to take roots in my territories?” The skull threw the soul into the ground.

“Bullying me?! Let me gather my souls first!” The soul shouted.

“Bah, your two friends know what they’re doing.” The skull said.

“Yes, feigning death and humiliating me, bastards.” The soul said.

Unfortunately, their screaming match didn’t change Gold Village’s current crisis, pressed by two major realms.

However, the enemies wanted the dream so they refrained from total destruction.

Thus, they must destroy the bull form first before coming inside Gold Village for the spring.

The bull continued to struggle, rolling back and forth with the other two entities. This was disastrous for the minor dream realms.

“What are you all doing?” Someone commented.

The woman immediately turned back and saw an ordinary youth.

“It’s you!” Her expression darkened since she saw him descend into the abyss. He should have been wounded and stuck in reality.

“Ruining this nice dream.” Li Qiye said and casually kicked the air. He was smaller than a speck of dust but somehow sent all three major realms in their physical manifestation rolling.

Silence returned to the dream world, accompanied by confusion. The tiny man kicked the dream worlds as if they were balls.

The woman couldn’t believe her eyes and staggered backward. All three dream entities stood up and stared down at Li Qiye.

“Okay, no more games.” Li Qiye said: “Surrender before it’s too late.”

“Sir, you are here for the three sources?” She took a deep breath and asked.

Their group came for the three springs of Heavenly Sin for the sake of becoming supreme overlords.

“Not interested, but the sources are not for you to take. Leave and I won’t kill you.” Li Qiye said.

His nonchalant demeanor bordered disdain. The primal ancestors didn’t appreciate this since they currently wielded the power of two major realms. This anger was hard to swallow.
